title: Book of Enoch (Ge'ez MS)
shelf_note: A Ge'ez parchment manuscript of 1 Enoch, written in three columns in an Ethiopic hand. This leaf has the end of the Parables (chs. 70–71) and the opening of the Astronomical Book (ch. 72), which matches the title and the BnF/16th-century description.
structure_note: The structure block shows pages_translated 0, but the pages_translated field says 310, so one of the two counters is wrong. The leaf carries a pencil folio number ('9') on the recto only, so the 17 backsteps and 14 repeats among 190 printed numbers most likely come from folio numbers being given to versos or misread, not from a scan splice. Page 21 = fol. 9 is consistent with a few leaves of front matter.

pages.layout: three columns of Ethiopic script; a red rubric line and red marginal sign open a new book in column 3; small red dot-and-dash marks between the columns

other.note: Raw '<column-break/>' appears twice in the English reading text
The opening rubric of the Astronomical Book is rendered as four '###' heading lines, broken mid-phrase ('...each according to their classes, / ### each according to their dominions...')

In several places the English follows the image or the standard text rather than the served OCR (e.g. 'from among those who dwell on the dry land' for OCR 'እምቅቅለ፡ የንደ፡ ዓዲ፡ በየብስ፡'; 'sons of the holy angels treading upon flames of fire' for OCR 'አውሎ፡ ስሙ፡ ለወለባ፡ እሳት'). These renderings are correct, but the two panes do not match.

missing.english: This is the third parable which I saw.
missing.why: Nothing tells the reader that this ends the Book of Parables (Similitudes) of 1 Enoch and that the next section is a different book.
This is a distinctive divine title, characteristic of the Parables. It recurs on the page without explanation.

missing.english: that Son of Man has appeared and has sat upon the throne of his glory
missing.why: The messianic 'Son of Man' figure is central to the passage and to its history of interpretation, and a general reader gets no gloss on it.

missing.english: The Book of the Order of the Lights of Heaven
missing.why: Nothing says that this opens the Astronomical Book (chs. 72–82) and its calendar of solar 'gates'.

book_verdict: The right leaf (fol. 9) of a genuine Ge'ez Enoch manuscript. About 13 lines of column 2 (1 En 71:11–16, including 'You are the Son of Man') are silently missing from the OCR and the translation and replaced by fluent filler. The lower half of column 3 is mostly garbled, and the English carries raw <column-break/> tags. The three notes are accurate.
